name: Druidfire
description: Provides drush commands and an API to alter field definitions.
project_description: Druidfire provides Drush commands and a PHP service API for altering existing entity field definitions in place: resizing text/string fields and converting field types (string to formatted text, Entity Reference Revisions to Entity Reference or to Bricks, string to taxonomy term reference). Each operation rewrites the SQL storage schema (via the keyvalue store 'entity.storage_schema.sql' plus direct DB schema ALTERs), the field.storage / field config, and the form/view display config, then clears cached entity definitions. Transformations are packaged as pluggable 'Spell' plugins (annotation-based plugin type in src/Plugin/Spell), so sites can add their own. There is no admin UI or configuration form; it is a developer/DevOps tool used from the CLI or from update/deploy hooks. Because it reshapes and can drop field storage, it must be run by trusted developers against a backed-up database.
